mil7.6.1:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, sīhassa satta angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni satta angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.6.1:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena seta-vimala-parisuddha-paṇḍaracittena byapagatakukkuccena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja sīhassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja sīho catucaraṇo vikkantacārī,
mil7.6.1:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena caturiddhipādacaraṇena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja sīhassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja sīho abhirūpa-rucira-kesarī,
mil7.6.1:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena abhirūparucira-sīla-kesarinā bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja sīhassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja sīho jīvitapariyādāne pi na kassaci oṇamati,
mil7.6.1:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena cīvara-piṇḍapātasenāsana-gilānapaccayabhesajja-parikkhāra-pariyādāne pi na kassaci oṇamitabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:4.3: Idaṃ mahārāja sīhassa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja sīho sapadānabhakkho, yasmiṃ okāse nipatati tatth' eva yāvadatthaṃ bhakkhayati, na varamaṃsaṃ vicināti;
mil7.6.1:5.2: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sapadānabhakkhena bhavitabbaṃ, na kulāni vicinitabbāni, na pubbagehaṃ hitvā kulāni upasankamitabbāni, na bhojanaṃ vicinitabbaṃ, yasmiṃ okāse kabaḷaṃ ādiyati tasmiṃ yeva okāse bhuñjitabbaṃ sarīrayāpanamattaṃ, na varabhojanaṃ vicinitabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:5.3: Idaṃ mahārāja sīhassa pañcamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja sīho asannidhibhakkho, sakiṃ gocaraṃ bhakkhayitvā na puna taṃ upagacchati,
mil7.6.1:6.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena asannidhikāraparibhoginā bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:6.3: Idaṃ mahārāja sīhassa chaṭṭhaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja sīho bhojanaṃ aladdhā na paritassati, laddhā pi bhojanaṃ agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno paribhuñjati,
mil7.6.1:7.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena bhojanaṃ aladdhā na paritassitabbaṃ, laddhā pi bhojanaṃ agadhitena amucchitena anajjhāpannena ādīnavadassāvinā nissaraṇapaññena paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:7.3: Idaṃ mahārāja sīhassa sattamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.6.1:7.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Saṃyuttanikāyavare theraṃ Mahākassapaṃ parikittayamānena:
mil7.6.1:8.1: Santuṭṭho 'yaṃ bhikkhave Kassapo itarītarena piṇḍapātena, itarītarapiṇḍapātasantuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, na ca piṇḍapātahetu anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjati, aladdhā ca piṇḍapātaṃ na paritassati, laddhā ca piṇḍapātaṃ agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjatīti.
